component.name: Ligature
component.summary: ER and UML class diagrams for school, with SQL

description.p: Ligature draws the diagrams computer science classes ask for, and does the tedious part for you.

ul.li: ER diagrams in Chen notation (rectangles, diamonds, attribute lollipops, (min,max) cardinalities) or crow's foot, switchable at any time
The logical schema and CREATE TABLE statements for MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite or standard SQL, following the usual school rules
UML class diagrams: attributes, operations, visibility, abstract classes, interfaces, inheritance, aggregation and composition
PNG, SVG and PDF export; PNG and SVG pictures keep the diagram inside, so they can be opened and edited again

description.p: The interface is compact: smaller text (never above 9 pt), tighter spacing and smaller icons and panels, instead of the zoom the size setting used to apply. "Automatic" size is 100% again.
The interface size set to Automatic is a compact 85% now (the shared toolkit's new standard; 80% and 90% are new choices). Larger sizes stay in Settings.
The interface size set to Automatic is the system's own size again (100%); the shared toolkit had made it 115%, which was too big. Larger sizes stay one choice away in Settings.
The look now comes from the suite's shared toolkit: darker text and firmer borders, larger captions, and a High contrast option in Settings.
The window can be made much narrower: the tool buttons show only their icons when the room is short.
Align or evenly spread a group of selected items. Notes for the database on the diagram and on every entity, relationship and class, saved in the file and written into the generated SQL as comments.
Alignment guides snap box edges too; the properties panel can be closed; Enter in an attribute goes straight to the next attribute's name.
Alignment guides now also snap to the 45° diagonals through other boxes.
Alignment guides: dragged boxes snap to the centre lines of other boxes.
Italian translation of the whole interface (Language in Settings; Italian systems start in Italian).
Pressing Enter in a one-line box now finishes with it: the cursor stops blinking and the box lets go of the focus.
Fixed: opening the app put a second icon on the dock instead of using the pinned one (the screen-size check forgot the app's desktop name).
Choose the interface size, and the window and Settings now fit small screens.
Cardinality labels no longer overlap the entities.
Pages you can't use yet are clearly greyed out in the sidebar.
Generalisations (ISA) with their translation to tables, copy and paste, warnings for missing keys, and updates from inside the app.
First release: ER diagrams (Chen and crow's foot) with SQL, UML class diagrams, and editable PNG/SVG exports.
